candidates.title: Google brings Dreambeans AI story app to India, first market outside the US
candidates.summary: Nov 2-3: Google Labs' experimental Dreambeans app expands to India (18+, free, Android & iOS); builds illustrated daily stories from Google apps you connect (Gmail, Calendar, Photos, YouTube, Search, Gemini) with no prompt; English + 13 Indian languages (14 total), one language at a time, no mixing; some stories animated with Veo; private, data deletable; Google warns it may hallucinate.
candidates.note: SELECTED. Official Google India blog + TechCrunch. Not used: '10-14 stories a day' (single source), US download decline (single source).

candidates.title: Anthropic's FlashProve: cryptographic proof of which AI model produced an answer
candidates.summary: Nov 3: open-source research system (zkSNARKs) where labs publish a model fingerprint and outputs can be checked against it without revealing weights; ~110 tok/s on one H100 with Llama 4 Maverick, CPU verify ~17-21 s; not deployed.
